citeAs: Clore, J., Cios, K., DeShazo, J., & Strack, B. (2014). Diabetes 130-US Hospitals for Years 1999-2008 [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5230J.
description: This dataset comprises ten years (1999–2008) of clinical care records from 130 U.S. hospitals and healthcare networks, focusing on patients diagnosed with diabetes. It includes 101,766 instances and 47 features describing patient demographics, hospital admissions, laboratory tests, medications, diagnoses, and prior healthcare utilization. Each record represents a single hospital encounter lasting between 1 and 14 days, where laboratory tests and medications were administered. The primary goal of the dataset is to predict early readmission within 30 days of discharge — a critical issue in diabetes management due to its implications for both patient outcomes and healthcare costs. Poor inpatient diabetes management can increase morbidity, mortality, and hospital expenses due to frequent readmissions. This dataset provides a valuable foundation for developing predictive models and clinical decision-support systems aimed at improving glycemic control, optimizing hospital care, and reducing readmission rates.
name: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals Dataset
headline: Predicting Early Readmission in Diabetic Patients Using Hospital Care Data (1999–2008)
